message.content:
對於無限長直導線，距離 \(r\) 的磁場大小可用下式計算：

\[
B=\frac{\mu_0 I}{2\pi r}
\]

其中  
- \(\mu_0 = 4\pi\times10^{-7}\,\text{T·m/A}\)（真空磁導率）  
- \(I = 2\,\text{A}\)  
- \(r = 4\,\text{m}\)

代入數值：

\[
B = \frac{(4\pi\times10^{-7})(2)}{2\pi\times4}
   = \frac{8\pi\times10^{-7}}{8\pi}
   = 1\times10^{-7}\,\text{T}
\]

即磁場強度為 **\(1\times10^{-7}\,\text{Tesla}\)**，或等同於 **\(0.1\,\mu\text{T}\)**。

方向則由右手法則決定：握住導線，拇指指向電流方向，四指捲曲的方向即為磁場方向。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "一根載有2安培電流的電線，距離4米的點的磁場是多少？" In Chinese: "A wire carrying a current of 2 amperes, what is the magnetic field at a point 4 meters away?" They want the magnetic field magnitude due to an infinite straight current-carrying wire at distance r.

Formula: B = μ0 I / (2π r). Where μ0 = 4π × 10^-7 T·m/A. So B = (μ0 I) / (2π r) = (4π×10^-7 * 2) / (2π*4) = (8π×10^-7) / (8π) = 10^-7 T? Let's compute: 8π×10^-7 / (8π) = 10^-7 T. Yes.

So answer: 1e-7 Tesla.

We can also express in microtesla: 0.1 µT? Wait 1e-7 T = 0.1 µT? Actually 1 µT = 1e-6 T. So 1e-7 T = 0.1 µT. So 0.1 microtesla.

Thus answer: 1×10^-7 Tesla or 0.1 µT.

We might mention direction using right-hand rule.

No need to call function.
